description: Choose how a listing you own earns a dofollow link (POST /api/agent/listing). Paid is the fastest route ($14.99 one-time, reviewed within 2 business days, no badge or wall to install) and returns a Dodo checkout URL whose metadata carries the submission id; the payment is verified server-side by the Dodo webhook. Free alternatives: sayabout (live Wall of Love URL) and badge, both reviewed after verification. Nothing publishes or self-grants dofollow here.

path.description: Inclusion path. 'paid' is the fastest dofollow route — $14.99 one-time, reviewed within 2 business days, nothing to install or verify, and it returns a Dodo checkout URL. 'sayabout' is free (live Wall of Love URL, reviewed within 2 business days); 'badge' is free (reviewed in 5-7 business days).

slug.description: Target a published tool you own (opens/reuses an upgrade request)

submissionId.description: Target a pending submission you own

verificationUrl.description: Required for sayabout (Wall of Love URL) / badge
